content.value: A room of a single storey building is to be air-conditioned having the data:
Size of the room: 20 x18 x 4 m high;
East side glass area: $1 0 ~ \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 }$
West side glass area: $1 5 \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 }$
South side glass area: $1 5 \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 }$
North side glass area: $1 0 ~ \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 }$
Solar gain through glass: West 510 W/m2; South 70 $\mathrm { { W / m ^ { 2 } } }$ East 50 $\mathrm { W } / \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 }$ and North 20 $\mathrm { W } / \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 }$ at 4 pm.
Overall heat transfer coefficient of roof = 3.5, wall = 4.5, and glass = 6.5 W/m²K.
Door in east wall: 3.5 x 3.0 m with $\mathrm { U } = 6 . 0 \ \mathrm { W } / \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 } \mathrm { K } ;$
Door in north wall: Two of each 4 $\lvert . 0 \times 3 . 0$ m with $\mathrm { U } = 6 . 0 \ \mathrm { W / m ^ { 2 } K }$

Equivalent temperature differentials at 4 pm are: E-wall = 14°C; $\mathrm { W - w a l l } = 1 5 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C } ;$ S-wall = $1 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C } ;$ N-wall $= 7 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ and Roof = 20C.
Infiltration through window crack: 2.5 m³/hr per m of crack.
Infiltration through door opening: 1.98 cmm
Windows: 7 windows of 4 x 3 m; occupancy: 80
Sensible and latent heat gain per person are75 W and 55 W respectively
Lighting: 2 kW florescent and 1 kW incandescent;
Appliances: 1.5 kW (sensible heat)
Ventilation: 0.27 cmm/person;
Outside conditions: 42 °C DB and $2 7 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ WB
Inside conditions: 24 C DB and 55% RH;
Assume maximum solar radiation comes at 4 pm, fan heat 5%, supply duct heat gain 1%, leakage 0.5% of room sensible heat and bypass factor of 0.15. Calculate -
(i) Effective room sensible heat
(ii) Effective room latent heat, and
(iii)Grand total heat on the air conditioning plant.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year Special Backlog Examination, 2020
